# uptimeify_status_page (Data Source)

Look up one status page by `id`, `slug` or `name` (exactly one). Fails when no or several visible pages carry the name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_status_page" "by_slug" {
  slug = "acme"
}

data "uptimeify_status_page" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric id or public id.
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `access_password_set_at` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `customer_id` (Number)
- `customer_name` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `has_password` (Boolean)
- `hidden_monitors` (Attributes Set) Monitors of the customer the page does not show. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hidden_monitors))
- `is_published` (Boolean)
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `public_id` (String)
- `subscription_delay_minutes` (Number)
- `subscriptions_enabled` (Boolean)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `visibility` (String) `public`, `customer_members_only` or `password_protected`.
